research_question: What is the effect of vocabulary interventions compared with standard care or no intervention on distal expressive second-language vocabulary measured immediately post-intervention in children up to six years old?
treatment_label: Vocabulary intervention (e.g., shared book reading, dialogic reading, explicit instruction, dual-language instruction)
control_label: Standard care, usual classroom instruction, or no intervention
outcome_description: Post-intervention expressive vocabulary in the second language assessed via a standardised or general measure of untaught/distal words
positive_direction: Higher SMD indicates better distal expressive second-language vocabulary in the intervention group compared to the control group (favours vocabulary intervention)
search_queries: preschool dual language learners vocabulary intervention randomized trial
second language children expressive vocabulary reading intervention experiment
young English learners distal vocabulary instruction controlled trial
inclusion_criteria: Randomised controlled trials evaluating vocabulary interventions (e.g., shared book reading, dialogic reading, explicit word teaching, dual-language instruction) in children up to six years of age learning a second language (L2)
Comparison condition of standard care, usual classroom curriculum, or no intervention
Quantitative reporting of distal (untaught/general) expressive vocabulary measured in the second language immediately post-intervention
exclusion_criteria: Not an original empirical study (systematic reviews, meta-analyses, editorials, opinion pieces, and theoretical papers are excluded)
No randomised comparison between a vocabulary intervention and a standard care/no intervention control group (e.g. non-randomised designs, or control group received another vocabulary intervention)

No quantitative outcome data for post-intervention distal expressive vocabulary in the second language (e.g. only proximal/taught-word vocabulary, only receptive vocabulary, only first-language outcomes, or combined receptive-expressive scores that cannot be disaggregated)
Study conducted exclusively with monolingual children or with children older than six years of age
moderators_to_extract: Intervention type (e.g., dialogic reading, explicit instruction, dual-language instruction)
Intervention delivery agent (e.g., classroom teacher, researcher, parent, speech therapist)
Grouping format (e.g., small group, whole class, individual)
Total intervention dosage or duration (hours or weeks)
Outcome instrument (standardised test name, e.g., EOWPVT, EVT)
Participant mean age or educational setting (preschool vs. kindergarten)
effect_size_note: Pool post-intervention distal expressive L2 vocabulary as SMD (Hedges' g) using a random-effects model. Convert SE/SEM to SD = SE * sqrt(n). For cluster-randomised trials without cluster-adjusted reporting, adjust sample sizes using design effect (1 + (M - 1) * ICC) with reported ICC or assumed ICC = 0.15. Multi-arm trials have intervention arms combined or the single most relevant arm selected. Exclude proximal (taught-word), receptive, and L1 outcomes.
